title: Jehoshaphat (king of Judah)
summary: King of Judah in Hales’s synopsis. He prints the name Jehosaphat. No earlier record of this king was in the data.
description: Added from the Hales import. Display only. Hales prints his own B.C. years in the synopsis and in Table XI. This chronology never sets a sort, and Jones, Appendix F (23rd ed., 2026), dates this and sets the sort.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 950 BC (no higher-tier year available).
